messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — QBR prep: marketplace credit allocations look off vs. scorecard signals. Can we recalibrate before Wed? :thinking_face:
Marco Chen: Agree. Noticed top SI partners used <50% of allocated credits last quarter. We should tie allocations to activation metrics, not just pipeline.
Sofia Ramos: What activation metric are we thinking? 'SI onboarded deals' or 'first 30d usage'?
Tom Brenner: From finance POV we need a clear rule: credits that don't convert -> clawback or reallocate. Need numbers by Mon COB. :money_with_wings:
Aisha Patel: Proposal: split partner credits into 3 buckets: Launch, Enablement, Strategic co-sell. Reallocate underutilized credits into Enablement pool. Draft sheet here: https://go.redwood/partnerships/marketplace-credits (read-only for now).
Marco Chen: Quick allocation logic sketch:
```
# pseudo-rule, used for scoring
if activation_rate >= 0.60:
  allocation += 0.20 * base_allocation
elif activation_rate >= 0.30:
  allocation += 0.05 * base_allocation
else:
  allocation -= 0.10 * base_allocation
  reassign_to = 'Enablement'
```
Sofia Ramos: That looks reasonable. Need to layer partner tier (Gold/Silver/Bronze) so Gold has a small buffer for joint announcements and marketplace promos.
Tom Brenner: I'll run a 6-month financial sensitivity: best/likely/worst for reallocation rules and share by Tue morning. Also recommend a 30% holdback for new credits until we see activation.
Aisha Patel: Can ops own the reassignment flow? @Marco can you shepherd the reassignments and update the sheet + scorecard mapping? We also need a one-pager for the QBR deck explaining the new buckets and scoring.
Marco Chen: Yup — I'll own it. Will post final allocations, the updated scorecard mapping, and a short narrative by Tue EOD.
deploy-bot: Reminder: QBR deck template updated — /doc/qbr-template v3 (link in #docs).
Sofia Ramos: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll add this to QBR agenda and loop in PMs for announcement planning.
